newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gigante sets 7.85 mln peso capital hike.
newsitem.headline: Gigante sets 7.85 mln peso capital hike.

text.p: Mexican retailer Grupo Gigante SA de CV will carry out a capital increase of 7.85 million pesos via the issue of 219,847,165 shares for subscription in the next two weeks, the company said Friday.
In a statement sent to the Mexican Stock Exchange, Gigante said the increase was agreed at ordinary and extraordinary shareholders meetings held September 18.
Gigante said that of the shares to be issued, 116,226,972 will be class II A shares and 103,620,193 will be class II B shares.
The price will be 2.27 pesos per share and subscription will be on the basis of 80 new shares for every 1,000 held.
Gigante also said that it would convert 330,000,000 B shares into the same amount of A shares Friday following a request by some shareholders at its annual general meeting March 29.
